School.title: School
School.description: Represents a single school, which acts as a tenant in the multi-tenant system. It holds core institutional information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the School entity.

name.description: The official, full name of the school.

motto.description: The inspirational motto or slogan of the school.

address.description: The physical address of the school.

phoneNumber.description: The primary contact phone number for administrative purposes at the school.

email.description: The primary contact email address for the school.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the school record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the school record was last updated.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents an individual user account with access to the system, linked to a specific school and associated with various roles (e.g., teacher, parent, admin).

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this user profile belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N UserProfile)

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user, used for communication and system access. This is distinct from authentication credentials.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the user, used for SMS notifications and contact.

roleIds.description: An array of IDs referencing the roles assigned to this user profile. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N Role)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the user account is currently active in the system.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: Defines a predefined system role with specific permissions and access levels (e.g., School Owner, Teacher, Parent).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Role entity.

name.description: The descriptive name of the role (e.g., 'School Owner', 'Headmaster', 'Teacher', 'Bursar', 'Parent').

description.description: A detailed explanation of the responsibilities and permissions associated with this role.

AcademicYear.title: AcademicYear
AcademicYear.description: Represents a specific academic year, defining the overarching period for school operations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AcademicYear entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School to which this academic year pertains. (Relationship: School 1:N AcademicYear)

name.description: The name of the academic year (e.g., '2023/2024').

startDate.description: The official start date of the academic year.

endDate.description: The official end date of the academic year.

isCurrent.description: Indicates whether this academic year is the currently active one for the school.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the academic year record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the academic year record was last updated.

Term.title: Term
Term.description: Represents an academic term or semester, a subdivision within an AcademicYear.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Term entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this term belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N Term)

academicYearId.description: Reference to the AcademicYear this term is part of. (Relationship: AcademicYear 1:N Term)

name.description: The name of the term (e.g., 'Term 1', 'First Semester').

startDate.description: The start date of the academic term.

endDate.description: The end date of the academic term.

isCurrent.description: Indicates whether this term is the currently active one for the school.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the term record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the term record was last updated.

Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: Represents an academic subject offered and taught at the school (e.g., Mathematics, History).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Subject entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School that offers this subject. (Relationship: School 1:N Subject)

name.description: The official name of the subject (e.g., 'Physics', 'Kiswahili').

code.description: A short, unique alphanumeric code for the subject (e.g., 'PHY101', 'KSW203').

description.description: A brief textual description of the subject's curriculum or content.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the subject record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the subject record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the subject is currently being offered or taught at the school.

Classroom.title: Classroom
Classroom.description: Represents a distinct academic class or stream (e.g., 'Form 1A', 'Primary 5 Science').

id.description: Unique identifier for the Classroom entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this classroom belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N Classroom)

name.description: The unique name or identifier for the classroom (e.g., 'Form 1A', 'Standard 7').

academicLevel.description: The academic level or grade associated with this classroom (e.g., 'Primary', 'O-Level', 'A-Level').

capacity.description: The maximum number of students that can be enrolled in this classroom.

description.description: A brief description or notes about the classroom.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the classroom record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the classroom record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this classroom is currently active and can have students assigned to it.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student currently or previously enrolled in the school.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Student entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School where this student is enrolled. (Relationship: School 1:N Student)

firstName.description: The first name of the student.

lastName.description: The last name of the student.

admissionNumber.description: The unique admission number assigned to the student upon joining the school.

admissionDate.description: The date when the student was first admitted to the school.

parentUserIds.description: An array of IDs referencing UserProfiles identified as parents or guardians of this student. (Relationship: Student N:N UserProfile)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the student record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the student record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the student is currently active (enrolled) in the school.

Enrollment.title: Enrollment
Enrollment.description: Records a student's enrollment in a specific classroom for a defined academic year and term.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Enrollment entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School where this enrollment is active. (Relationship: School 1:N Enrollment)

studentId.description: Reference to the Student who is enrolled. (Relationship: Student 1:N Enrollment)

classroomId.description: Reference to the Classroom the student is enrolled in. (Relationship: Classroom 1:N Enrollment)

academicYearId.description: Reference to the AcademicYear of this enrollment. (Relationship: AcademicYear 1:N Enrollment)

termId.description: Reference to the Term of this enrollment. (Relationship: Term 1:N Enrollment)

enrollmentDate.description: The date on which the student was officially enrolled in this class for the period.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the enrollment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the enrollment record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this enrollment is currently active.

TeacherAssignment.title: TeacherAssignment
TeacherAssignment.description: Links a specific teacher (UserProfile) to a subject and a classroom for an academic period.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TeacherAssignment entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School where this assignment is made. (Relationship: School 1:N TeacherAssignment)

teacherUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the teacher assigned to this teaching role. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N TeacherAssignment)

classroomId.description: Reference to the Classroom where the subject is being taught. (Relationship: Classroom 1:N TeacherAssignment)

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject that is assigned to be taught. (Relationship: Subject 1:N TeacherAssignment)

academicYearId.description: Reference to the AcademicYear during which this assignment is valid. (Relationship: AcademicYear 1:N TeacherAssignment)

termId.description: Reference to the Term during which this assignment is valid. (Relationship: Term 1:N TeacherAssignment)

startDate.description: The start date of this teacher's assignment.

endDate.description: The end date of this teacher's assignment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the assignment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the assignment record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the teacher's assignment is currently active.

Exam.title: Exam
Exam.description: Defines an exam or continuous assessment (CAT) for a specific subject and classroom.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Exam entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School where this exam is conducted. (Relationship: School 1:N Exam)

name.description: The descriptive name of the exam (e.g., 'Mid-Term Physics Exam', 'Biology CAT 1').

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject that this exam is testing. (Relationship: Subject 1:N Exam)

classroomId.description: Reference to the Classroom for which this exam is intended. (Relationship: Classroom 1:N Exam)

academicYearId.description: Reference to the AcademicYear in which the exam is conducted. (Relationship: AcademicYear 1:N Exam)

termId.description: Reference to the Term in which the exam is conducted. (Relationship: Term 1:N Exam)

maxScore.description: The maximum possible score a student can achieve on this exam.

examDate.description: The date when the exam was administered.

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile (typically a teacher or academic admin) who created this exam definition. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Exam)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the exam record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the exam record was last updated.

ExamResult.title: ExamResult
ExamResult.description: Records a student's performance on a specific exam, including raw score and NECTA-compliant grading.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ExamResult entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School where this exam result was recorded. (Relationship: School 1:N ExamResult)

studentId.description: Reference to the Student who received this result. (Relationship: Student 1:N ExamResult)

examId.description: Reference to the Exam this result pertains to. (Relationship: Exam 1:N ExamResult)

rawScore.description: The unadjusted numerical score obtained by the student in the exam.

nectaGradePoint.description: The NECTA-compliant grade point assigned based on the raw score and academic level (e.g., 1 for 'A', 5 for 'F' in O-Level).

nectaGradeLetter.description: The NECTA-compliant letter grade (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F') derived from the raw score.

gradedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile (typically the subject teacher) who recorded this result. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ExamResult)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the exam result record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the exam result record was last updated.

AttendanceRecord.title: AttendanceRecord
AttendanceRecord.description: Tracks a student's attendance status for a specific date and classroom session.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AttendanceRecord entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School where this attendance was recorded. (Relationship: School 1:N AttendanceRecord)

studentId.description: Reference to the Student whose attendance is being recorded. (Relationship: Student 1:N AttendanceRecord)

classroomId.description: Reference to the Classroom for which attendance is recorded. (Relationship: Classroom 1:N AttendanceRecord)

academicYearId.description: Reference to the AcademicYear of this attendance record. (Relationship: AcademicYear 1:N AttendanceRecord)

termId.description: Reference to the Term of this attendance record. (Relationship: Term 1:N AttendanceRecord)

attendanceDate.description: The specific date for which the attendance is recorded.

recordedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile (typically a teacher or admin) who recorded this attendance. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N AttendanceRecord)

notes.description: Any additional notes or remarks regarding the attendance.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the attendance record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the attendance record was last updated.

FeeStructure.title: FeeStructure
FeeStructure.description: Defines different categories of fees and their associated rules and amounts, applicable for specific academic levels and periods.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FeeStructure entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this fee structure belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N FeeStructure)

name.description: A descriptive name for the fee (e.g., 'Form 1 Tuition Fee - Full Board', 'Exam Fee - NECTA O-Level').

feeType.description: The category of the fee (e.g., 'Tuition', 'Boarding', 'Transport', 'Exam', 'Uniform', 'Other Services').

amount.description: The standard monetary amount for this fee component.

academicLevel.description: The academic level (e.g., 'Primary', 'O-Level', 'A-Level') to which this fee applies. Can be 'All' if universal.

academicYearId.description: Reference to the AcademicYear during which this fee structure is valid. (Relationship: AcademicYear 1:N FeeStructure)

termId.description: Reference to the Term during which this fee structure is valid (optional, if term-specific). (Relationship: Term 1:N FeeStructure)

description.description: A detailed explanation of what the fee covers and any conditions.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the fee structure record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the fee structure record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this fee structure is currently active and applicable for billing.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Represents a generated bill for a student, detailing amounts due based on applied fee structures.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Invoice entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School that issued this invoice. (Relationship: School 1:N Invoice)

studentId.description: Reference to the Student for whom this invoice is generated. (Relationship: Student 1:N Invoice)

academicYearId.description: Reference to the AcademicYear this invoice pertains to. (Relationship: AcademicYear 1:N Invoice)

termId.description: Reference to the Term this invoice pertains to. (Relationship: Term 1:N Invoice)

issueDate.description: The date when the invoice was officially issued.

dueDate.description: The date by which the payment for this invoice is expected.

totalAmountDue.description: The total monetary amount expected from this invoice.

totalAmountPaid.description: The cumulative amount of money already paid against this invoice.

balance.description: The outstanding balance remaining to be paid on this invoice.

status.description: The current payment status of the invoice (e.g., 'Pending', 'Paid', 'Partially Paid', 'Overdue', 'Cancelled').

controlNumber.description: A unique control number generated for external payment gateway reconciliation, particularly for mobile money payments.

description.description: A brief textual description or notes about the invoice's contents or purpose.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the invoice record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the invoice record was last updated.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Records a specific payment transaction made against an invoice by a student or parent.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Payment entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School that received this payment. (Relationship: School 1:N Payment)

invoiceId.description: Reference to the Invoice to which this payment is applied. (Relationship: Invoice 1:N Payment)

studentId.description: Reference to the Student associated with this payment. (Relationship: Student 1:N Payment)

paymentDate.description: The date and time when the payment was received or processed.

amount.description: The monetary amount of the payment made.

paymentMethod.description: The method used for this payment (e.g., 'Mobile Money', 'Bank Transfer', 'Cash').

transactionReference.description: A unique reference number from the payment method or internal system for tracking.

gatewayTransactionId.description: The transaction ID provided by the payment gateway (e.g., M-Pesa, ClickPesa), if applicable.

recordedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile (bursar/admin) who recorded this payment, or system if automated. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Payment)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the payment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the payment record was last updated.

Resource.title: Resource
Resource.description: Represents an educational resource (e.g., document, video link) uploaded and shared within the school community.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Resource entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School that owns this resource. (Relationship: School 1:N Resource)

uploaderUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the individual who uploaded this resource. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Resource)

title.description: The title or name of the educational resource.

description.description: A brief textual description of the resource's content or purpose.

fileUrl.description: The URL or path where the resource file is stored (e.g., cloud storage, internal server).

resourceType.description: The type or format of the resource (e.g., 'Document', 'Video', 'Image', 'External Link', 'Audio').

subjectId.description: Reference to the Subject this resource is primarily related to (optional). (Relationship: Subject 1:N Resource)

classroomId.description: Reference to the Classroom this resource is specifically intended for (optional). (Relationship: Classroom 1:N Resource)

uploadDate.description: The date when the resource was originally uploaded.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the resource record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the resource record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the resource is currently active and accessible to users.

Hostel.title: Hostel
Hostel.description: Represents a physical hostel building or dormitory provided by the school for boarding students.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Hostel entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School that operates this hostel. (Relationship: School 1:N Hostel)

name.description: The name of the hostel (e.g., 'Boys' Dormitory A', 'Girls' Hostel Block').

capacity.description: The total maximum student capacity of the entire hostel building.

genderAccommodation.description: Specifies the gender of students accommodated in the hostel (e.g., 'Male', 'Female', 'Mixed').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the hostel record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the hostel record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the hostel is currently operational and accepting students.

Room.title: Room
Room.description: Represents an individual room within a hostel, where students are assigned.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Room entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this room belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N Room)

hostelId.description: Reference to the Hostel this room is part of. (Relationship: Hostel 1:N Room)

roomNumber.description: The unique number or identifier for the room within its hostel (e.g., '101', 'A-2B').

capacity.description: The maximum number of students that can be accommodated in this specific room.

currentOccupancy.description: The current number of students assigned to this room.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the room record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the room record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the room is currently active and available for student assignments.

StudentHostelAssignment.title: StudentHostelAssignment
StudentHostelAssignment.description: Records a student's assignment to a particular room within a hostel for a specific academic period.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudentHostelAssignment entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School managing this hostel assignment. (Relationship: School 1:N StudentHostelAssignment)

studentId.description: Reference to the Student who is assigned to the hostel room. (Relationship: Student 1:N StudentHostelAssignment)

roomId.description: Reference to the Room the student is assigned to. (Relationship: Room 1:N StudentHostelAssignment)

academicYearId.description: Reference to the AcademicYear of this hostel assignment. (Relationship: AcademicYear 1:N StudentHostelAssignment)

startDate.description: The effective start date of the student's hostel assignment.

endDate.description: The effective end date of the student's hostel assignment.

feeStructureId.description: Reference to the FeeStructure that governs the boarding fees for this assignment. (Relationship: FeeStructure 1:N StudentHostelAssignment)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the assignment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the assignment record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the student's hostel assignment is currently active.

BusRoute.title: BusRoute
BusRoute.description: Defines a transportation route for school buses, including details like name, description, and fare.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BusRoute entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School that operates this bus route. (Relationship: School 1:N BusRoute)

name.description: The descriptive name of the bus route (e.g., 'Route A - City Center', 'Northern Express').

description.description: A detailed description of the bus route, including major stops or geographical coverage.

fareAmount.description: The standard fare amount associated with using this bus route. This can be superseded by FeeStructure.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the bus route record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the bus route record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the bus route is currently active and operational.

StudentTransportAssignment.title: StudentTransportAssignment
StudentTransportAssignment.description: Records a student's assignment to a specific bus route for a given academic period.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudentTransportAssignment entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School managing this transport assignment. (Relationship: School 1:N StudentTransportAssignment)

studentId.description: Reference to the Student who is assigned to the bus route. (Relationship: Student 1:N StudentTransportAssignment)

busRouteId.description: Reference to the BusRoute the student is assigned to. (Relationship: BusRoute 1:N StudentTransportAssignment)

academicYearId.description: Reference to the AcademicYear of this transport assignment. (Relationship: AcademicYear 1:N StudentTransportAssignment)

startDate.description: The effective start date of the student's transport assignment.

endDate.description: The effective end date of the student's transport assignment.

feeStructureId.description: Reference to the FeeStructure that governs the transport fees for this assignment. (Relationship: FeeStructure 1:N StudentTransportAssignment)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the assignment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the assignment record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the student's transport assignment is currently active.

Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: Represents a staff member of the school, encompassing details for HR, payroll, and statutory compliance. May be linked to a UserProfile if they have system access.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Employee entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this employee works for. (Relationship: School 1:N Employee)

firstName.description: The first name of the employee.

lastName.description: The last name of the employee.

employeeIdNumber.description: A unique employee ID number assigned by the school for internal identification.

nationalIdNumber.description: The employee's national identification number, used for statutory deductions and reporting.

email.description: The employee's primary email address for communication.

phoneNumber.description: The employee's primary phone number for contact.

position.description: The employee's job title or position within the school (e.g., 'Teacher', 'Bursar', 'Head of Department').

hireDate.description: The date when the employee commenced employment at the school.

terminationDate.description: The date when the employee's employment was terminated (optional, for historical records).

bankAccountName.description: The name of the account holder for salary payments. (Sensitive PII, stored securely).

bankName.description: The name of the bank where the employee's salary account is held. (Sensitive PII, stored securely).

bankAccountNumber.description: The employee's bank account number for salary payments. (Sensitive PII, stored securely and potentially encrypted).

userProfileId.description: Reference to the UserProfile if this employee also has a system login. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Employee)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the employee record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the employee record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the employee is currently actively employed by the school.

SalaryComponent.title: SalaryComponent
SalaryComponent.description: Defines a constituent part of an employee's salary, such as basic pay, allowances, or statutory deductions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SalaryComponent entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School that defines this salary component. (Relationship: School 1:N SalaryComponent)

name.description: The name of the salary component (e.g., 'Basic Salary', 'Housing Allowance', 'PAYE Tax').

componentType.description: The category of the component, either 'Earning' (adds to gross pay) or 'Deduction' (subtracts from gross pay).

isStatutory.description: Indicates whether this component is a mandatory statutory deduction (e.g., NSSF, PAYE) imposed by government regulations.

amountOrRate.description: The default fixed amount or a percentage rate for this component. The actual value for payroll may be dynamically calculated.

description.description: A detailed description of what the salary component represents or how it is applied.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the salary component record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the salary component record was last updated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the salary component is currently active and can be applied in payroll calculations.

PayrollRecord.title: PayrollRecord
PayrollRecord.description: Stores a complete payroll entry for an individual employee for a specific pay period, including gross pay, deductions, and net pay.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PayrollRecord entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School that generated this payroll record. (Relationship: School 1:N PayrollRecord)

employeeId.description: Reference to the Employee for whom this payroll record is generated. (Relationship: Employee 1:N PayrollRecord)

academicYearId.description: Reference to the AcademicYear this payroll record pertains to. (Relationship: AcademicYear 1:N PayrollRecord)

payPeriodStartDate.description: The start date of the pay period covered by this payroll record.

payPeriodEndDate.description: The end date of the pay period covered by this payroll record.

grossPay.description: The total gross salary amount earned by the employee before any deductions.

totalDeductions.description: The aggregate sum of all deductions applied to the employee's gross pay.

netPay.description: The net salary amount paid to the employee after all deductions.

status.description: The processing status of the payroll record (e.g., 'Processed', 'Paid', 'Pending Approval', 'Draft').

processedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile (typically a bursar or HR admin) who processed this payroll record. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N PayrollRecord)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the payroll record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the payroll record was last updated.

SchoolCustomization.title: SchoolCustomization
SchoolCustomization.description: Stores school-specific customization settings, such as visual theme (colors, fonts) and uploaded logo.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SchoolCustomization entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School to which these customization settings apply. (Relationship: School 1:1 SchoolCustomization)

logoUrl.description: The URL to the school's logo image file, used for branding across the application and reports.

primaryColor.description: The hexadecimal code for the school's primary branding color (e.g., '#1F5BA6').

backgroundColor.description: The hexadecimal code for the primary background color used in the school's custom theme (e.g., '#ECF0F6').

accentColor.description: The hexadecimal code for the school's accent color, used for interactive elements and highlights (e.g., '#945CE6').

headlineFont.description: The name of the font selected for headlines and prominent text (e.g., 'Space Grotesk').

bodyFont.description: The name of the font selected for general body text (e.g., 'Inter').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the customization record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the customization record was last updated.

definition.description: Top-level collection for each school tenant. Documents here represent core school information. Includes denormalized 'ownerUserId' and 'members' map for school-level authorization.
Global collection for all user profiles. Each document contains the user's `schoolId` and `roleIds` for direct authorization checks based on `request.auth.uid` without hierarchical dependencies.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user, matching `request.auth.uid`.

definition.description: Global collection defining system-wide roles. These are typically read-only for most users.

params.name: roleId
params.description: The unique identifier for the role.

definition.description: Subcollection storing school-specific customization settings like branding, colors, and logo. This is a single document for a 1:1 relationship with the school. Includes denormalized 'schoolId' from the path.

params.name: schoolId
params.description: The unique identifier of the school.

definition.description: Subcollection for academic years specific to a school. Includes denormalized 'schoolId' from the path.

params.name: schoolId
params.description: The unique identifier of the school.

params.name: academicYearId
params.description: The unique identifier for the academic year.

definition.description: Subcollection for academic terms within a specific academic year for a school. Includes denormalized 'schoolId' and 'academicYearId' from the path.

params.name: schoolId
params.description: The unique identifier of the school.

params.name: academicYearId
params.description: The unique identifier for the academic year.

params.name: termId
params.description: The unique identifier for the term.

definition.description: Subcollection for academic subjects offered by a school. Includes denormalized 'schoolId' from the path.

params.name: schoolId
params.description: The unique identifier of the school.

params.name: subjectId
params.description: The unique identifier for the subject.

definition.description: Subcollection for academic classrooms/streams within a school. Includes denormalized 'schoolId' from the path.

params.name: schoolId
params.description: The unique identifier of the school.

params.name: classroomId
params.description: The unique identifier for the classroom.

definition.description: Subcollection for student records belonging to a school. Includes denormalized 'schoolId' from the path, and 'parentUserIds' for direct parental access authorization.

params.name: schoolId
params.description: The unique identifier of the school.

params.name: studentId
params.description: The unique identifier for the student.

definition.description: Subcollection for student enrollment records. Includes denormalized 'schoolId' from the path and 'parentUserIds' for direct parental access authorization without lookup dependencies.

params.name: schoolId
params.description: The unique identifier of the school.

params.name: enrollmentId
params.description: The unique identifier for the enrollment record.

definition.description: Subcollection linking teachers to subjects and classrooms. Includes denormalized 'schoolId' from the path and 'teacherUserId' for direct teacher access authorization.

params.name: schoolId
params.description: The unique identifier of the school.

params.name: teacherAssignmentId
params.description: The unique identifier for the teacher assignment.

definition.description: Subcollection for exam definitions within a school. Includes denormalized 'schoolId' from the path and 'createdByUserId' for direct creator authorization.

params.name: schoolId

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed as a multi-tenant system, with each school serving as a top-level tenant. This is achieved by placing all school-specific data under a `/schools/{schoolId}` top-level collection, ensuring strong data isolation and simplifying security rules. User authentication is handled via a global `/userProfiles/{userId}` collection, which stores the user's associated `schoolId` and `roleIds`. This centralized `UserProfile` acts as the primary source for a user's identity and permissions across the system. The `roles/{roleId}` collection holds system-wide role definitions, which are read-only for most users.

**Authorization Independence via Denormalization:**

To ensure authorization independence and eliminate complex `get()` calls in security rules, critical authorization contexts have been denormalized across related documents. The core principle here is to embed the necessary authorization metadata directly within the document being accessed, rather than relying on lookups to parent documents or other related entities.

1.  **School-level access:** The `School` entity itself will include `ownerUserId` and a `members` map (`members: {uid: "role"}`) for direct authorization checks for managing school-level settings. This prevents a `get()` call to a separate 'school_members' collection for basic school administration.
2.  **User Profiles:** The `userProfiles/{userId}` document directly contains `schoolId` and `roleIds`. While accessing this document is a `get()` operation, it is always on a *known* document (`/userProfiles/$(request.auth.uid)`) and serves as the primary source for the authenticated user's global context. This is generally accepted as a base for authorization and avoids complex hierarchical lookups.
3.  **Parental Access to Student Data (QAPs):** For secure `list` operations (QAPs) and `get` operations for parents accessing their children's data, all student-centric subcollections (`Enrollment`, `ExamResult`, `AttendanceRecord`, `Invoice`, `Payment`, `StudentHostelAssignment`, `StudentTransportAssignment`) will denormalize the `parentUserIds` array directly from the `Student` document. This allows a rule like `allow read: if request.auth.uid in resource.data.parentUserIds;` without any `get()` calls, enabling efficient and secure querying of all data related to a parent's children.
4.  **Employee Access to Personal Data (QAPs):** Similarly, for an employee to access their `PayrollRecord`, the `PayrollRecord` document will include an `employeeUserId` field, which stores the `UserProfile.id` of the linked employee. This enables a direct check like `allow read: if request.auth.uid == resource.data.employeeUserId;` for personal payroll records, facilitating secure and independent access.
5.  **Teacher Access to Assignments/Exams:** `TeacherAssignment` documents include `teacherUserId` and `Exam` documents include `createdByUserId`. This allows teachers to access and manage their specific assignments or exams directly, using `request.auth.uid == resource.data.teacherUserId` or `request.auth.uid == resource.data.createdByUserId` respectively.

**Querying for Access Patterns (QAPs):**

The structure directly supports QAPs:

*   **School Administration:** All school-level entities are nested under `/schools/{schoolId}/`, allowing school administrators to query all data for their `schoolId` using a `where('schoolId', '==', getUserProfile(request.auth.uid).schoolId)` clause (with `schoolId` also denormalized in each document for easy filtering). Firebase security rules can then enforce role-based access based on `getUserProfile(request.auth.uid).roleIds`.
*   **Parental View:** Parents can efficiently query all records related to their children (e.g., invoices, exam results, attendance) by filtering on the denormalized `parentUserIds` field, such as `db.collectionGroup('invoices').where('parentUserIds', 'array-contains', request.auth.uid)`. The security rule would then permit `list` and `get` operations if `request.auth.uid in resource.data.parentUserIds`.
*   **Teacher/Employee View:** Teachers can query their assigned subjects or classes, or view results they graded, by filtering on `teacherUserId` or `createdByUserId`. Employees can query their payroll records using `employeeUserId`. These fields are present in the respective documents, supporting `list` operations.

**Structural Segregation:**

All documents within a given collection (`e.g., /schools/{schoolId}/students`, `/schools/{schoolId}/invoices`) inherently share the same security posture because they all belong to a single school and are accessed by users with roles defined for that school. There are no mixed-security-posture documents (like public vs. private posts) within the same collection, simplifying rule writing. The multi-tenant design ensures logical segregation at the highest level, and consistent denormalization further solidifies security predictability.
